image_check: 2026-10-18: all base_sha256 equal the installed files in contract image.tarball (sha256 97f09c68...3c48), layer blobs/sha256/32e1eac0abca43f74..., usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/<rel>; no whiteouts; the five P-07 entries (2026-10-19) are git show 49cb2bbf only, not checked against the tarball [unverified]

vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/specialized_d.why: R-UP-CAP route-id probe (perfbot_kernels.routecap); off unless PERFBOT_ROUTECAP=1, record() returns before any torch op

vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/dspark/sp.why: P-10 (iii-A) fused Markov sampler (perfbot_kernels.markov_sampler, lane P 525880c, kernel/PATCH.md); off unless PERFBOT_EXP_MARKOV=1: run() declines and the image loop runs; capture() warms the fused round before the draft graph capture

vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py.why: P-07 form K: the two switches (read once at import; PERFBOT_EXP_KDA_CKPT=1 turns on parts (1)+(2) and the part (3) skip; PERFBOT_EXP_KDA_HASHFIX=1 the skip alone); part (1) vllm#60888 mid-block branch of is_mamba_prefill_checkpoint_valid (col == init when the start is not block-aligned); perfbot_p07_fresh_ok, the part (2) gate shared by scheduler, manager and worker

vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py.why: P-07 part (2) scheduler gate: one added clause in _mamba_block_aligned_split, the col <= init shape only on a request's first chunk (num_computed_tokens == 0)

vllm/v1/core/single_type_kv_cache_manage.why: P-07 part (2) manager gate in MambaManager._needs_internal_checkpoint (request not yet allocated); part (3) vllm#60888 cache_blocks skip (a chunk that starts mid-block and runs past the boundary never publishes that slot under the full-block hash), on iff HASHFIX=1 or CKPT=1

vllm/model_executor/layers/mamba/checkpo.why: P-07 part (2) worker gate: compute_mamba_prefill_checkpoints declines the col <= init shape on a row that is not fresh; fresh rows come from PERFBOT_P07_FRESH_ROWS (None = all fresh = base); "# PERFBOT P-07 ckptlog" lines: the PERFBOT_EXP_KDA_CKPT_LOG switch (read once at import; the log module perfbot_kernels.kda_ckptlog loads only when it is 1) and the read-only source-digest hook after the export launch

vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_states/mamba_hy.why: P-07 part (2) worker flag source (V2): a row is fresh on its first chunk after add_request (the row the runner sent whole, new or resumed); set only when PERFBOT_EXP_KDA_CKPT=1; "# PERFBOT P-07 ckptlog" lines: the read-only read-back hook (perfbot_kernels.kda_ckptlog.note_step) at the start of preprocess_state, None unless PERFBOT_EXP_KDA_CKPT_LOG=1

vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/model.py.why: ARM-TIME item 1, one switch per line pair at the start of build_specialized_decode, before SpecializedDecode is built: PERFBOT_EXP_INITTIME=1 calls perfbot_kernels.inittime.install(), which wraps the build's constructors and cute.compile in place and only times and prints (PERFBOT-INITTIME lines); PERFBOT_EXP_CUTE_CACHE=1 calls perfbot_kernels.cutecache.install() (E17c), which lets cute.compile use the CuTe DSL's own file cache (PERFBOT-CUTECACHE lines); PERFBOT_EXP_CUTE_PRETRACE=1|export calls perfbot_kernels.pretrace.install() (ARM-TIME Option A), which keys cute.compile before the trace and loads the exported module on a hit (PERFBOT-PRETRACE lines); and one pair at the start of KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration.__init__, before the loader asks for weights: PERFBOT_EXP_LOADTIME=1 calls perfbot_kernels.loadtime.install() (W1'), which wraps default_loader's fastsafetensors_weights_iterator global and only times and prints (PERFBOT-LOADTIME lines); off = the module does not load

vllm/v1/worker/gpu_worker.py.why: CGPROFILE, determine_available_memory: profile_cudagraph_memory() runs only when VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS is set; unset, upstream discards its estimate (cudagraph_memory_estimate_applied = 0) after a full capture pass (~43 s at server start), so the KV cache size is unchanged; set, the file is upstream

vllm/model_executor/warmup/flashinfer_au.why: W5 narrow key: flashinfer_autotune_cache_hash returns perfbot_kernels.atkey.key(vllm_config) (model, quantization, parallel sizes, max_num_batched_tokens, drafter, KV dtype, PERFBOT_ATKEY_SALT) in place of sha256(VllmConfig.compute_hash()), so every arm loads the one tuning of record (autotune-record/)
